usedFor: Eventzilla collects registrations and Freshsales Classic holds deals, so “Create Deal” can follow each “New Registration”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: “Create Deal” links the deal to an account and creates the contact if it is missing.

watchOut: “Registration Is Updated” also reaches “Create Deal”, so an edited registration could open a second deal.
